courses.summary: 以皮爾巴拉鐵礦供應鏈的一個採礦節點，研究礦石品質、運搬與緩衝。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A mining node in the Pilbara supply chain examines ore quality, transport and buffering. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
